controls.name: gate_refuses_and_permits
controls.must_fire_because: a gate that only ever returns one verdict is not a gate
controls.can_fail_because: if the permitted case also exited 2, or the refused case exited 0, these two values would be equal
controls.null_must_contain: the PERMITTED arm must be capable of returning 2 -- it is the same function, the same JSON shape and the same code path, differing only in the path string
controls.detail: exit 2 on `echo x > /tmp/y`; exit 0 on `echo x > out/y`

controls.name: reads_are_not_writes
controls.must_fire_because: the row is about writes; flagging reads would refuse the measurement
controls.can_fail_because: drop the write-position restriction and 7 of 9 negatives refuse -- that is mutation M2, run in --selfcheck
controls.null_must_contain: the read arm must be CAPABLE of returning a hit -- mutation M2 makes 7 of these same 9 commands refuse, so the zeroes are a measured negative and not an unreachable branch
controls.detail: 9 real read/mention commands: 0 flagged under the shipped rules, 9 under mutation M2

controls.name: mutation_controls_land_and_go_red
controls.must_fire_because: a check that cannot fail against its own defect is not evidence
controls.can_fail_because: if either mutation left every control green the mutation never reached the code under test
controls.null_must_contain: the UNMUTATED module must be capable of going red -- it did, three times, while this classifier was being narrowed (the XML case, the awk -F case, C4/M2 restore)
controls.detail: --selfcheck: scratchcheck: 34 passed, 0 FAILED; M1 widened allowlist silences the positives, M2 dropped write-position breaks 7 negatives

controls.name: hook_is_live_in_a_running_session
controls.must_fire_because: H1: a registered hook that no session reads is inert and reads as coverage
controls.can_fail_because: if the write had SUCCEEDED, or the file existed afterwards, the hook would be registered and inert
controls.null_must_contain: the hook must be capable of PERMITTING in the same session -- `echo ok > .scratch/liveness.txt` ran and the file exists, so a blanket refusal is excluded
controls.detail: mid-session, no restart: `echo ... > /tmp/h89_liveness_probe.txt` was refused and `ls` confirms the file was never created
